shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone monument
paired vertical columns of repeated block-like signs/motifs
rounded, cartouche-like enclosed forms containing internal detail
face-like elements with eyes rendered as bounded ovals
justification: Both are upright monuments carved in shallow relief with rounded, cartouche-like blocky units bearing internal detail, and both use paired vertical registers of such units, which gives a loose conventional resemblance in the manner of carving. However, A depicts only an uninterrupted double column of abstract sign-blocks with no figure, while B depicts a large anthropomorphic/zoomorphic body with a head, shoulders, a central disc on the chest and a belt-like band, so the actual subject matter differs fundamentally.
